english.title: Drive a vehicle other than on the carriageway of a motorway
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a part of the motorway , namely **(..SPECIFY PART OF MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..) which was not part of the carriageway
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 5 of the Motorways Traffic (England and Wales) Regulations 1982, section 17(4) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes:
(i) See H3379 for driving on the hard shoulder.
(ii) See H393 for driving on central reservation.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

6 months
